answer.reason: The verses tell of Neco's dealings with Judah's kings after Josiah's death and of his army's defeat at Carchemish, beyond what the summary states.

clauses.english: put Jehoahaz in bands and carried him off to Egypt
clauses.quote: put him in bands at Riblah in the land of Hamath

clauses.english: made Eliakim king in Josiah's place and renamed him Jehoiakim
clauses.quote: made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the room of Josiah his father

clauses.english: saw his army beaten by Nebuchadrezzar at Carchemish
clauses.quote: which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote

doubts: The killing of Josiah is left out because the summary already names it.
